title: Batch Update Vulnerabilities
description: Update the status, priority, or add a comment to all selected vulnerabilities at once. Only filled fields will be applied.
dismissalReasonPlaceholder: Why are these findings being dismissed? (max 512 characters)
dismissalReasonRequired: Required to dismiss this finding. The justification is recorded on the selected item and exported to your GRC platform.
dismissalReasonRequired_other: Required to dismiss findings. This justification is recorded on all {{count}} selected items and exported to your GRC platform.
resolvedWarning: If this vulnerability is detected again by a later scan, it will be reopened. If it is a false positive and you don't want it to come back in future scans, use the “{{ignoredStatus}}” status instead.
resolvedWarning_other: Any selected vulnerability detected again by a later scan will be reopened. If these are false positives and you don't want them to come back in future scans, use the “{{ignoredStatus}}” status instead.
ignoredInfo: This vulnerability will not come back in future scans: its status is kept even if it is detected again. Use it for a false positive, an accepted risk or any other reason not to fix it.
ignoredInfo_other: The selected vulnerabilities will not come back in future scans: their status is kept even if they are detected again. Use it for false positives, accepted risks or any other reason not to fix them.
hint: Leave a field empty to keep the current value for that property.
partialSuccess: Some vulnerabilities could not be updated
errorGeneric: An error occurred while updating vulnerabilities
maxSelectionWarning: Maximum 100 vulnerabilities can be updated at once
